pronunciation.approximation: Say "asanga" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Asanga".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "asanga" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Asanga" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Asanga
domains.subtitle: Yogacara
domains.lead: Asanga is yogacara, mind-only. The name means "Without attachment" and belongs to the buddhist tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name
cards.desc: The restoration Asanga returns the figure to scholarly recognition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in buddhist myth, cult, and cultural memory.

cards.name: Unicode Restoration
cards.desc: Preserved as a flagship temple despite the unregistrable plain-ASCII form.

symbols.name: Name
symbols.meaning: The restored form Asanga, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.

mythology.lead: The stories of Asanga place yogacara, mind-only at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Asanga appears in buddhist tradition as yogacara, mind-only. The name's meaning, "Without attachment", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Asanga in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Asanga remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
